name: Ashraf Rushdie
original_name: アシュラフ＝ルシュディ
source:
The first in line to become the successor to the throne of the Shamsu kingdom. He has an easygoing demeanor, and is quite a philanthropist.

However, he has a hidden cold-hearted side as well, and shows no mercy for those who provoke him. There's a great darkness hidden in his heart.

[Translated from official site]
